title: Birth in Algiers in 1887
summary: Bocage gives his name and says he was born July 31, 1887, in Algiers, where his grandfather had a truck farm.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Ready to go. First thing we usually ask is your name. Your full name.
Peter Edwin Boccage. Boccage in French, you know.
And when were you born and where?
This side of the river or over there?
Algiers, right here in Algiers, yeah.
Right up here, about two, three blocks up there on Brooklyn. And I think it was Ptolemy Street, you know. My grandfather at the time had a, when there was a farm, like, you know, truck farm.
